quest:Rift_Ripper1.name: Entering_The_Rift...
quest:Rift_Ripper1.description: Get these random items to gain access to The Rift.

quest:Royal_Worm6.name: A_Royal_Gift
quest:Royal_Worm6.description: Bring an entire 10,000,000 greenstack of Worm Tails

item:Quest70.name: Phone_Box
item:Quest70.description: IdleOn is out on iOS devices! The Rift Ripper must have kept a few of these back when he played during the iOS Launch event... Hold down to open, and a random reward will drop at your feet!

item:Quest71.name: Gem_Envelope
item:Quest71.description: Contains a random number of gems, hold down to open! It could be just a couple gems, but it could also have as many as 10,000 gems!

item:Timecandy9.name: Cosmic_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy9.description: Hold down to get anywhere from 5 hours to 500 hours of AFK time! Gives 24 hrs on average. Odds are: 54% for 5-10hr, 25% for 10-25hr, 18% for 25-100 hr, 2.1% for 100-499hr, 0.4% for 500hr.

item:GalaxyA2b.name: Lost_Batteries
item:GalaxyA2b.description: Oh, THATS why the remote wasn't working when I pushed the buttons, the batteries were all the way out here in the rare drop table!

item:GalaxyA1.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
item:GalaxyA1.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

item:Weight14.name: Fat_Albert
item:Weight14.description: Hold down to add this accessory to it to your fishing toolkit, where it can be accessed by all characters! Oh Albert, what were you thinking? Seriously, I genuinely can't comprehend what you were thinking haha!

item:GalaxyC1b.name: Pearler_Shell
item:GalaxyC1b.description: Yow wow wow! This one's got a pearl in it!!

pageProps.seoDescription: Wurm Tail is a Legends of Idleon item: dropped by 1 monster, quest reward. That's a nice tail!
